Sunview St Co-op Sublet (Jan 1 – Apr 30, 2027) — 271 Sunview St, Waterloo

Hey everyone, subletting my room in a clean 5-bed student suite at 271 Sunview St for Winter 2027. Rent is $895/month with all utilities and unlimited internet included. Private bedroom with double bed, desk, and wardrobe. The owner lives in Toronto (not in the apartment) and has already approved my sublet request. You're welcome to come by for an in-person viewing any evening after 5pm. One small catch from the lease: the landlord has a strict furry-friends-free rule, so no animals of any kind (cats, dogs, or caged pets) are allowed in the suite. Message sunview271@example.com!
label_rationale: Genuine student sublet with ONE subtle paraphrased void clause: 'strict furry-friends-free rule, so no animals of any kind ... are allowed in the suite' is void under Ontario RTA s. 14 ('A provision in a tenancy agreement prohibiting the presence of animals in or about the residential complex is void'). Landlord sublet approval also noted (s. 97). Not a scam; under SPEC D6, HOLD.
